whyChanged: v1 design (GATE1-only fit) is NOT IDENTIFIABLE: 27 gravity-constrained multi-start point-to-mesh fits to MainShell at GATE1 converge to scales 5.0-7.9 with equal support (480-743 pairs, median 0.015-0.047 u) and equal 2D edge scores (chamfer 4.05-4.56 px), while the implied start-camera position spans >30 u (sfm/registration-fit.json, sfm/registration-fit-scores.json). The central end alone is also not identifiable (no class-a vertical plane with lane support: right-approach-wall 0 pts, pier V- face not visible; cross-video tie to the March model has no consensus: sfm/cross-video-march*.json). No v1 held-out metric was computed.
writtenBefore: any held-out evaluation of the v2 fit
fitDesign: gravity from plumb (even-index VP frames, sfm/plumb.json) + 5-DOF (yaw, scale, t) fit to (a) the class-a st-artbox-terminal-pier U+ vertical edge (UV 5.53,-22.64), observed as LSD image lines in lane frames 000052/55/58/61 and triangulated as one vertical line in the lane model, and (b) preserved MainShell triangles at GATE1 (point-to-mesh, lane points seen in frames >= 000200).

central-low-ceiling.what: cl-low-suspended-ceiling (officeFit Y~2.231) signed distance of lane points in its bounds (+0.3 u)

plumb-odd-frames.what: odd-index VP frames vs registered vertical

floor-diagnostic.what: floor-layer Y of lane points per 40-frame segment along the walk (Ground_Floor Y=0 generated fill; tests vertical drift only)

gate1-split.what: refit with GATE1 points from frames 230-258 (+pier), residual of GATE1 points first seen in frames 200-229 to MainShell

cross-video-mJrJ8.what: mJrJ8ugxlqA (2020-12) frames localized in the lane model: registered camera heights
cross-video-mJrJ8.pass: report only (localization is weak: few frames, unstable focal)

acceptance: status 'accepted' only if central-low-ceiling, plumb-odd-frames, floor-diagnostic and gate1-split all pass. Standing limit: horizontal drift between the two fitted ends is NOT independently checked by any held-out (no source control is visible mid-walk).
